details: Having the ability to make a personal server would be great, if we could take the load off of the other VRChat servers and make our own private servers where we could adjust things about the player count limit and other server related things for our own servers, there has been someone who worked on this feature separately from the main devs where you could setup your own server that no one but people with the setup or permission could join which would be cool being locally built into the game. Also this could improve ping depending on if the people joining your server live near you and in that case you could have a locally hosted server for you and your friends to use. Also it could allow for the ability for local testing of worlds and avatars to your server for those to be able to join without uploading to the main servers. Also having local databases would be great for load times if the worlds you visit most often or avatars could be loaded first onto the main server and whenever they are updated it downloads them so when you want to join them you have it on your local server where you and local friends have faster access to and the files are off the computer using less of the cache. If anyone else has ideas I'd love to hear them.(:
title: Personal Servers
